items.source: name - the name of the element being bound
items.translation: name - 被绑定元素的名称

items.source: target - the item being bound
items.translation: target - 被绑定的项

items.source: context - the bind context
items.translation: context - 绑定上下文

items.source: Default no-op bind handler.
items.translation: 默认的空操作绑定处理器。

items.source: Called when binding of an element starts but before any result has been determined.
items.translation: 当元素绑定开始但尚未确定任何结果时调用。

items.source: Exception - if the binding isn't valid
items.translation: Exception - 如果绑定无效

items.source: Called when binding fails for any reason (including failures from onSuccess(ConfigurationPropertyName, Bindable, BindContext, Object) or onCreate(ConfigurationPropertyName, Bindable, BindContext, Object) calls).
items.translation: 在因任何原因（包括来自onSuccess(ConfigurationPropertyName, Bindable, BindContext, Object)或onCreate(ConfigurationPropertyName, Bindable, BindContext, Object)调用的失败）绑定失败时调用。

items.source: Called when binding fails for any reason (including failures from onSuccess(ConfigurationPropertyName, Bindable, BindContext, Object) or onCreate(ConfigurationPropertyName, Bindable, BindContext, Object) calls). Implementations may choose to swallow exceptions and return an alternative result.
items.translation: 在因任何原因（包括来自onSuccess(ConfigurationPropertyName, Bindable, BindContext, Object)或onCreate(ConfigurationPropertyName, Bindable, BindContext, Object)调用的失败）绑定失败时调用。实现可以选择吞掉异常并返回替代结果。

items.source: Called when binding finishes with either bound or unbound result. This method will not be called when binding failed, even if a handler returns a result from onFailure(ConfigurationPropertyName, Bindable, BindContext, Exception).
items.translation: 在绑定完成（无论结果是已绑定还是未绑定）时调用。如果绑定失败，即使处理器从onFailure(ConfigurationPropertyName, Bindable, BindContext, Exception)返回了结果，此方法也不会被调用。

items.source:
Called when binding of an element ends with an unbound result and a newly created
instance is about to be returned. Implementations may change the ultimately
returned result or perform addition validation.
items.translation: 当元素的绑定以未绑定的结果结束，且即将返回新创建的实例时调用。实现可以更改最终返回的结果或执行额外的验证。

items.source: result - the newly created instance (never null)
items.translation: result - 新创建的实例（永远不会为 null）

items.source: the actual result that should be used (must not be null)
items.translation: 应使用的实际结果（不能为null）

items.source: Callback interface that can be used to handle additional logic during element binding.
items.translation: 可用于在元素 绑定 期间处理额外逻辑的回调接口。

items.source:
Called when binding of an element ends with an unbound result and a newly created
instance is about to be returned.
items.translation: 当元素的绑定以未绑定的结果结束，且即将返回新创建的实例时调用。

items.source: Called when binding finishes with either bound or unbound result.
items.translation: 绑定完成时调用，无论结果是已绑定还是未绑定。

items.source: Called when binding of an element ends with a successful result.
items.translation: 当元素的绑定以成功结果结束时调用。

items.source:
Called when binding of an element ends with a successful result. Implementations
may change the ultimately returned result or perform addition validation.
items.translation: 当元素的绑定以成功结果结束时被调用。实现可以更改最终返回的结果或执行附加验证。

items.source: T - the bindable source type
items.translation: T - 可绑定源类型

items.source: result - the bound result (never null)
items.translation: result - 绑定结果（永远不会为 null）

items.source: result - the bound result (may be null)
items.translation: result - 绑定的结果（可能为 null）

items.source: the actual item that should be used for binding (may be null)
items.translation: 实际用于绑定的项目（可能为null）

items.source: the actual result that should be used (may be null)
items.translation: 应使用的实际结果（可能为null）

items.source: error - the cause of the error (if the exception stands it may be re-thrown)
items.translation: error - 错误的起因（如果异常被抛出，它可能会被重新抛出）

items.source: the actual result that should be used (may be null).
items.translation: 应使用的实际结果（可能为null）。

items.source: Phillip Webb, Madhura Bhave
items.translation: Phillip Webb，Madhura Bhave

items.source: Field Details
items.translation: 字段详情
